notes.title: Our demo has been updated! Here is the March 1st update log.
notes.notes:
Wow, our demo has been updated!
In this update, we've added a Christmas costume for Alice and fixed some bugs. Come to the game and get your Christmas Alice!

[h2][b]Fixes & Optimizations[/b][/h2]
[olist]
[*] Added[b] Christmas Alice costume[/b].
[*] Changed the way to [b]obtain Christmas Alice[/b] - now available in Snowman Chests.
[*] The mini map has been modified and the large map function is ready to be added.
[*] Fixed the issue where "Jiangjiangxiang" was destroyed for a long time, causing the prologue mission to be unable to progress.
[*] Fixed several bugs in Desert Transformation that prevented players from leaving the spawn point.
[*] Fixed the error where "Four Way Battle" did not contribute positive stars.
[*] Fixed an issue where weapons could not be selected in the main menu inventory.
[*] Fixed an issue where recruited bunker materials would not refresh correctly.
[*] Added functionality for cinema cassette videos and recommended ratings.
[*] The PVE settlement system has been modified and the problem of incorrect settlement of passenger aircraft has been fixed.
[*] Fixed an issue where skins were not settling correctly after exiting the game.
[*] Treasure chest drop mechanism compensation.
[*] Fixed floating water issue in Ark Paradise.
[/olist]

We will continue to update in the future and work hard to bring you a more comfortable gaming experience!

If any player encounters any problems during the game or has suggestions, please feel free to join our Discord and contact us. 

We will remain active and carefully review every suggestion and feedback to continuously optimize.
